text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At Chairwoman Akikawa's behest, a Trainer Pep Rally was to be held.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: A pep rally! This will be a wonderful opportunity to fire everyone up once again.
choice_data_list: Indeed! I'm looking forward to seeing how it turns out.
Indeed! I'm looking forward to seeing how it turns out

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Today is a big day for all the Trainers. Let's make it a massive success, committee team!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Alright, 10 minutes until opening! Let's do the final check, everyooonnne!

text_block_list.name: Committee Member A
text_block_list.text: Right!! First up, checking the equipment! Spotlights, microphones... wait, huh?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: What?! There was an ordering mix-up and we don't have speakers?!

text_block_list.name: Committee Member A
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I'm so sorry, really! What do we do? We won't have any sound at all like this...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Don't panic! The academy hosts tons of events. Let's go look for a substitute!

text_block_list.name: Committee Member A
text_block_list.text: Here's a mic, here's a penlight, and here's... a conch shell horn?! No good, gotta check the next spot—!

text_block_list.name: Committee Member A
text_block_list.text: Eek?! U-Um, did I just press something...?

text_block_list.name: Committee Member A
text_block_list.text: ...Ouch! Ow, I kicked something~~~

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Are you alright?! Everyone stay still! I'll look for the switch!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Alright, this is the spot! Speaker, speaker...

text_block_list.name: Committee Member A
text_block_list.text: Ow...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Are you okay?! Does the spot you bumped hurt?

text_block_list.name: Committee Member A
text_block_list.text: N-No... I can move. But—

text_block_list.name: Committee Member A
text_block_list.text: Ugh... *sob*, I'm so sorry. I keep causing nothing but trouble for everyone... I won't touch anything else, I promise...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Thinking it's better if you do nothing at all, huh.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I get it, I totally get that feeling!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Even when you try your best, the results just don't follow... and you end up feeling like everything you do just ruins things. It makes you feel so down. I totally get it~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: But there's one more thing I know for sure!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Failure isn't the end!

text_block_list.name: Committee Member A
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Let's search for a speaker right up until the very last second! Or find something that can take its place!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Like playing music through a megaphone, for example! There have gotta be plenty of ways!

text_block_list.name: Committee Member A
text_block_list.text: No... we didn't have megaphones either... There was a conch shell horn, but... that sounds pretty ridiculous, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: A conch shell horn...! It makes a sound, and that sounds awesome—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah! This can work!!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's almost time to begin! Hehe, I wonder what kind of rally it will be.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (HOOOOOOOOO~~ HOOOOOOOO~~~!!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Everyone, now! Close the curtains!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Alright!! Next, stage crew! Spotlights, OOOOOON!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Inspiration! Leaders inscribed into the great history of this academy! I hereby declare the opening of the Pep Rally——!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Everyone got your conch shells ready?! Let's hype it up!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: All together now, BLOOOOW~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHHHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The resounding blast of the conch shell horns echoed straight to our cores. And thus, the pep rally kicked off in the most spectacular fashion imaginable.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Heheh, see how thrilled everyone is? Even if you mess up, it's not the end!

text_block_list.name: Committee Member A
text_block_list.text: Yes... YES...!! Um!

text_block_list.name: Committee Member A
text_block_list.text: For never giving up until the very end, Biko-san, you're my true hero!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: See? As long as you don't give up, anything is possible!

text_block_list.name: Committee Member A
text_block_list.text: Yes! ...Alllriiiight!! I'll go see if there's anything else I can help with!
